description: Crypto market monitor for the CardputerZero

store.summary: Live crypto prices, search by symbol and charts from 1H to 1Y
store.description: Track the crypto market on your CardputerZero. The dashboard shows the top coins (BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, XRP) with price, 24h change and a sparkline. Search any coin by its symbol (e.g. PEPE), open a chart for 1H, 24H, 7D, 30D or 1Y with high/low, 24h volume and a cursor to inspect each point, and pin favorites to the dashboard. US$ or R$, dark or light theme, English or Portuguese. Data from the public Binance and CoinGecko APIs (no account or key). Informational only, not financial advice.
